# The Absolutely Wonderful "Worst" Features of Every US State

**Alabama** - Blessed with humidity so thick you can practically swim through the air, ensuring you'll never need to pay for a sauna membership again while your clothes permanently fuse to your skin!

**Alaska** - Enjoy mosquitoes the size of small helicopters that thoughtfully donate their proboscis acupuncture services completely free of charge during your entire summer!

**Arizona** - Experience the thrill of accidentally branding yourself on your car's seatbelt buckle, because who doesn't love spontaneous third-degree burn tattoos in 120°F heat?

**Arkansas** - Home to dry counties where you can experience the nostalgic charm of Prohibition-era America and drive 50 miles for a beer like it's a sacred pilgrimage!

**California** - Where a modest 800 sq ft bungalow costs only $2.3 million, teaching you valuable lessons about minimalism and the spiritual emptiness of material possessions!

**Colorado** - Altitude sickness ensures every visitor gets the authentic experience of feeling drunk without spending money on alcohol - what a bargain!

**Connecticut** - Boasting the highest electricity rates in the continental US, because nothing says "luxury living" like paying premium prices to keep your lights on!

**Delaware** - Featuring absolutely nothing of interest whatsoever, providing the zen-like experience of pure existential emptiness on I-95!

**Florida** - Where Florida Man provides daily free entertainment and alligators thoughtfully appear in your swimming pool to remind you that nature still exists!

**Georgia** - Gnats that lovingly fly directly into your eyes, nose, and mouth, providing free protein and testing your reflexes all summer long!

**Hawaii** - Everything costs triple the mainland price, helping you appreciate the simple joy of bankruptcy while surrounded by paradise!

**Idaho** - Offering the cultural excitement of potato worship and absolutely nothing else to do after 8 PM, perfect for mandatory early bedtimes!

**Illinois** - Featuring corruption so refined it's practically an art form, with governors who thoughtfully transition directly from the State House to the Big House!

**Indiana** - Providing the sensory experience of driving through 500 miles of identical cornfields, like a meditation retreat for people who hate variety!

**Iowa** - The exotic aroma of industrial pig farms wafting through the air, offering free aromatherapy that makes you appreciate not having a sense of smell!

**Kansas** - So magnificently flat you can watch your dog run away for three days, providing unparalleled lessons in perspective and loss!

**Kentucky** - Where dry counties border wet counties, creating a delightful patchwork of confusion and spontaneous road trips for basic beverages!

**Louisiana** - Roads with potholes so deep they've formed their own ecosystems, offering free vehicle suspension tests every 50 feet!

**Maine** - Black flies that enthusiastically feast on your flesh all summer, because who doesn't want to donate blood to thousands of tiny vampires?

**Maryland** - Old Bay on literally everything, including desserts, because why taste actual food when you can taste only Old Bay forever?

**Massachusetts** - Drivers who treat traffic laws as gentle suggestions and turn signals as signs of weakness, keeping your fight-or-flight response properly exercised!

**Michigan** - Roads that helpfully destroy your car's alignment annually, supporting the local auto repair economy with your mandatory donations!

**Minnesota** - Winter temperatures that freeze your nostril hairs instantly, providing the unique sensation of breathing through icy straws for six months!

**Mississippi** - Proudly maintaining last place in education rankings, because someone has to make the other 49 states feel better about themselves!

**Missouri** - Meth labs in charming rural settings, bringing Breaking Bad's excitement to real-life neighborhoods near you!

**Montana** - More cows than people, ensuring you'll have plenty of meaningful conversations with livestock when human contact becomes too much!

**Nebraska** - An entire state that serves as one giant highway rest stop between actual destinations, perfecting the art of being forgettable!

**Nevada** - Where gambling addiction is a state-sponsored retirement plan and slot machines thoughtfully appear in grocery stores for your convenience!

**New Hampshire** - The "Live Free or Die" state that ironically requires you to wear seatbelts, because freedom means mandatory safety compliance!

**New Jersey** - The intoxicating industrial aroma of the Turnpike, providing a free chemical peel for your sinuses every time you drive through!

**New Mexico** - Green chile on absolutely everything including coffee, because your digestive system was getting too comfortable anyway!

**New York** - $20 sandwiches and $3,000/month studio apartments the size of closets, teaching you that poverty builds character even with a six-figure salary!

**North Carolina** - Gerrymandered districts that look like modern art, ensuring your vote has all the impact of a whisper in a hurricane!

**North Dakota** - Winter winds that helpfully sandblast the skin off your face, providing free microdermabrasion services for eight months a year!

**Ohio** - The birthplace of more astronauts than any other state, because even natives desperately want to leave the planet entirely!

**Oklahoma** - Tornadoes that thoughtfully rearrange your neighborhood's layout annually, keeping things fresh and exciting!

**Oregon** - Where it rains 300 days a year and locals pretend to love it, cultivating a collective Stockholm syndrome with precipitation!

**Pennsylvania** - Pittsburgh and Philadelphia with Alabama in between, offering the unique experience of time travel to the 1950s just by driving!

**Rhode Island** - So small you can miss the entire state by blinking on the highway, providing lessons in the impermanence of existence!

**South Carolina** - Palmetto bugs (aka flying cockroaches) the size of small birds, because regular insects weren't terrifying enough!

**South Dakota** - Featuring the thrilling Corn Palace, because nothing says "tourist destination" like a building covered in corn cobs!

**Tennessee** - Nashville's bachelorette party invasion every weekend, where "Woo Girls" thoughtfully shriek on pedal taverns at 2 AM!

**Texas** - Everything is bigger, including the ego, ensuring you'll never forget you're in Texas because someone will remind you every 30 seconds!

**Utah** - Where you can't buy real beer in grocery stores and bars thoughtfully measure your drinks with precision scientific equipment to ensure minimal fun!

**Vermont** - More expensive than Hawaii despite being landlocked and frozen, because maple syrup apparently justifies bankruptcy!

**Virginia** - Traffic on I-95 that moves at the speed of continental drift, giving you plenty of time to contemplate your life choices!

**Washington** - The Seattle Freeze, where locals are so politely unfriendly you'll question your own existence while surrounded by passive-aggressive niceness!

**West Virginia** - Mountain roads with no guardrails and 500-foot drops, providing free adrenaline rushes and informal physics lessons!

**Wisconsin** - Where cheese is considered a food group and hearts thoughtfully clog themselves to support the local cardiac surgery industry!

**Wyoming** - Wind so strong it can literally blow trains off tracks, offering the excitement of potentially becoming airborne while walking to your car!
